messages:
claire: Heads-up — noticed p95 on console for /v1/generate jumped from ~180ms → ~420ms after the routing policy change at 10:22am. API-side p95 from the raw request logs is ~190ms. Anyone else seeing this?
juan: I saw the alert. Console rollup and raw API metrics disagree a lot after that rollout. Might be a merge/weighting issue.
sasha: @claire can you paste the console query or an example screenshot? Also which window are we looking at?
claire: Query used by console snapshot: 
```
rollup_percentile(latency_ms, p=0.95, by=[route], window=5m)
```
Time window = last 1h. Spike aligns with routing policy change that reweighted traffic across subroutes.
meera: Observability shows traffic shifted: many requests moved to route:b which has longer token sequences and different batching behavior. That can change tail latencies, but not usually this magnitude.
juan: probable cause: console does percentile after merging per-subroute rollups. Our current tdigest rollups don't carry correct sample_count in the metadata, so a naive merge can skew percentiles when subroute sample counts differ.
ron: yep — we've hit this before for multi-region merges. If you merge t-digests without sample counts or with inconsistent compression params you can bias high/low.
product-anna: From product/customer side: customers get confused when console p95 doesn't match the API/observed numbers. We should surface why and give guidance ASAP.
claire: proposal for short-term: surface sample_count next to percentile values in the UI and add a tooltip explaining rollup merging accuracy. Also, for small windows (<15m) or when subroute sample variance > 3x, fall back to raw distribution query instead of merged rollup.
sasha: UI change is straightforward — add a "samples" column and an info tooltip. I can ship that in ~1 day.
juan: backend fix: add sample_count to the tdigest rollup proto and include it in rollup.metadata, then use weighted merges. Pseudopatch: 
```
message Rollup { bytes tdigest = 1; int64 sample_count = 2; }
```
Need to update exporters and the aggregator to persist sample_count. Migration + deploy coordination ~3 days.
meera: note — switching to raw distribution queries more often will raise query cost. We need a cap: if total_samples > 100k, fallback to approximate merge but show a warning banner with confidence note.
juan: agree, we'll implement thresholds. Also we should ensure TDigest compression param is stable across shards so merges are safe.
sasha: I'll add the UI bits and the confidence banner. Can we add a little demo tooltip text: "Percentiles derived from rollups — accuracy depends on per-subroute sample counts. Click to see raw distribution." 
claire: perfect. @juan can you start the rollup proto change and migration branch today? We need to avoid more customer pings.
juan: starting branch now. PR will include backward-compatible decoding for older rollups. ETA 3d.
dev-bot: deploy queued for juan/tdigest-samplecount (staging) :rocket:
claire: ok — we'll post progress in #rollouts and add a console banner while migration is in flight. thanks folks :thumbsup:
